curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Peter Smith
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Recruitment and Organization in the Bábí and Early Baha’i Movements | Peter Smith

sheet.Title / Topic: Recruitment and Organization of the Babi and Early Baha'i Movements: A Resource Mobilization Perspective
sheet.Brief Description: The Resource Mobilization Perspective is a particular approach in the Sociology of Social and Religious Movements which focuses on the practicalities by which social and religious movements are organized and mobilize the resources they need to achieve their objectives.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Siyamak Zabihi-Moghaddam
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Shaykh Ṭabarsí  A Turning Point in the Bábí Faith

sheet.Title / Topic: Shaykh Tabarsi: A Turning Point in the Bábí Faith
sheet.Brief Description: The episode of Shaykh Tabarsi in Mazandaran in 1848–49 was a turning point in the history of the Bábí movement in Iran. It was the first time that the Qajar state, hitherto content with incarcerating the Báb in a remote corner of the country, resolutely moved to suppress the Bábís.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Baharieh Maani Rohani
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Women of Consequence in the Life of the Báb | Baharieh Maani Rohani

sheet.Title / Topic: Women of Consequence in the Life of the Báb
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar is about women closely related to The Bab who stand out in stature and the poignancy of their services. Top on the list are Fatimih Bagum; His wife, Khadijih Bagum and her sister, Zahra Bagum. Their lives will be discussed in light of the Writings revealed in their honor and about them.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Part 1: The Báb’s Artistry in His Commentary on the Súrih of Joseph | Todd Lawson

sheet.Title / Topic: The Báb’s Artistry in His Commentary on the Súrih of Joseph
sheet.Brief Description: The new dispensation announced by the Báb challenged existing notions of religion and revelation. The Báb’s commentary on the Súrih of Joseph is a highly intricate and complex composition which betrays the authorial presence of the young messiah at every word.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Part 2: Understanding the Báb’s Audience- The Blessed Beauty in Islam | Todd Lawson

sheet.Title / Topic: Understanding the Báb’s Audience- The Blessed Beauty in Islam
sheet.Brief Description: The Islamic philosophic or mystical tradition, frequently indistinguishable from the Islamic tradition in general, has long been distinguished by the intensity with which it venerates and celebrates certain specific divine teachings from the Qur’án or the Hadith on the spiritual value of beauty.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Part 3: The Báb’s Great Announcement to Mulla Husayn: Chapter 1 of the Qayyúmu’l-Asmá’ | Todd Lawson

sheet.Title / Topic: The Báb’s Great Announcement to Mulla Husayn: Chapter One of the Qayyúmu’l-Asmá’, The Súrih of Dominion (Mulk)
sheet.Brief Description: In the Kitáb-i-Íqán Mulla Husayn is referred to by Bahá’u’lláh thus: But for him, God would not have been established upon the seat of His mercy, nor ascended the throne of eternal glory.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Armin Eschraghi
curated_sacred_traditions.title: The Báb’s Tablet about the Special Prophethood of Muhammad | Armin Eschraghi

sheet.Title / Topic: The Báb’s Tablet about the Special Prophethood of Muhammad
sheet.Brief Description: A short introduction to the history and background of the Báb’s “Treatise on Specific Prophethood”, and then investigate whether this text, like all early Writings of the Báb, might also be read, on a second layer, as a promotion of the Báb’s own claim to receiving Divine Revelation.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Michael Day
curated_sacred_traditions.title: The Shrine of the Báb: Recent Research Findings | Michael V Day

sheet.Title / Topic: The Shrine of the Báb: Recent Research Findings on its Establishment, Completion and Embellishment
sheet.Brief Description: Topics of interest surrounding The Shrine of the Bab: concealment of the Báb’s casket and its transfer to the Holy Land, building design, storage and interment of the casket, funeral of the Master, role of the Guardian with respect to the Shrine, design of the superstructure and -construction preparation, building of the dome, decision to build the Terraces, architect’s inspiration,  and construction and completion details.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: John Hatcher
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Face of God Among Us" | John Hatcher

sheet.Title / Topic: The Face of God Among Us
sheet.Brief Description: The Face of God Among Us (2010) is a highly structured analysis of the Manifestations of God, based entirely on passages from the authoritative Bahá’í texts.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Ian Kluge
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Baha'i Proofs for God"  | Ian Kluge

sheet.Title / Topic: The Baha’i Proofs for God
sheet.Brief Description: This web talk focuses on the Baha'i Proofs of God, based on the writings of Baha'u'llah and particularly `Abdu'l-Baha.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Anne Perry
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Where Spirit Intersects Art" | Anne Perry

sheet.Title / Topic: Where Spirit Intersects Art
sheet.Brief Description: This web talk focuses on the Baha'i perspective of the relationship between spirituality and art.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Christopher Buck
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "God and Apple Pie: Religious Myths and Visions of America" | Chris Buck

sheet.Title / Topic: God and Apple Pie: Religious Myths and Visions of America
sheet.Brief Description: This web talk is an original analysis of ten different myths and visions of America.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Moojan Momen
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Shoghi Effendi and Baha'i History: "The Dawn Breakers" | Moojan Momen

sheet.Title / Topic: The Re‑Creation and Utilization of a Community’s Memories: Shoghi Effendi and Baha’i History
sheet.Brief Description: In this presentation, Dr. Moojan Momen discusses his research into the importance and history of the "The Dawn Breakers" translated by the Guardian of the Baha'i Faith Shoghi Effendi.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Sandra Lynn Hutchison
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Accessing the Meaning of the Bahá’í Revelation” | Sandra Lynn Hutchison

sheet.Title / Topic: Accessing the Meaning of the Bahá’í Revelation
sheet.Brief Description: How can we approach the combined works that comprise Bahá’í scripture in a systematic way? What skills can we develop to help us as readers in our search for the “hidden gift” that Bahá’u’lláh tells us is “contained” in the Word of God?

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Susanne Alexander
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Healthy, Unified Marriages As Service to Humanity" | Susanne Alexander
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Baha'i Web Talks #07 A presentation exploring the idea of healthy, unified marriages as service to humanity. Focus Questions ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Healthy, Unified Marriages As Service to Humanity
sheet.Brief Description: A presentation exploring the idea of healthy, unified marriages as service to humanity.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Arthur Lyon Dahl
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Navigating the Storm: The Transition to Sustainability"  |  Arthur Lyon Dahl

sheet.Title / Topic: Navigating the Storm: The Transition to Sustainability
sheet.Brief Description: Sustainable development is development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Baharieh Rouhani Maani
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Leaves of the Twin Divine Trees" | Baharieh Rouhani Maani

sheet.Title / Topic: The Leaves of the Twin Divine Trees
sheet.Brief Description: Among the women covered are the two who bore and raised the Twin Manifestations of God, also those who suffered immensely, sacrificed their all and never wavered in their love for and selfless service to the Cause of the Bab and Baha’u’llah.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Sovaida Ma'ani Ewing
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Building a World Federation: Solving Our Global Crises" | Sovaida Ma’ani Ewing

sheet.Title / Topic: Building a World Federation: The Key to Solving Our Global Crises
sheet.Brief Description: This talk will both propose the steps that need to be taken towards the creation of global federation institutions and demonstrate how the establishment of its constituent institutions will facilitate the solutions to our seemingly intractable global problems.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Steve Friberg
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Science and Religion: Harmonious Development" | Steve Friberg

sheet.Title / Topic: Science and Religion: Harmonious Development
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar discusses the teachings of the Baha'i Faith focusing on science and religion going hand-in-hand.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Shahrokh Monjazeb
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Baha'u'llah and the Birth of the New Revelation" Part 1 | Shahrokh Monjazeb

sheet.Title / Topic: Veiled and Concealed in the Hidden Habitation of His Inner Being: The Birth of the New Revelation in the Síyáh-Chál Prison
sheet.Brief Description: What happened to Baha’u’llah when He was incarcerated in the Siyah-Chal (the Black Pit) in 1853? Did He know He was a Manifestation before then? Did He receive revelation before then? How was His mission inaugurated? What do we know about the event? What is the meaning of the work He revealed there, the Rashh-i-Ama?

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Brian Aull
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Baha’i Consultation: A Revolutionary Model of Democratic Governance | Brian Aull

sheet.Title / Topic: Consultation: A Revolutionary Model of Democratic Governance
sheet.Brief Description: This presentation reviews the principles of consultation and the seven requisite qualities that participants cultivate to make it successful. It contrasts consultation to other processes, such as adversarial debate, negotiation, compromise, and consensus building. Finally, it discusses the importance of consultation as a model of governance that can address the ills besetting the world’s political systems.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Vasu Mohan
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Gender Equality: Five Revolutionary Teachings" | Vasu Mohan

sheet.Title / Topic: Five Revolutionary Teachings on Gender Equality in the Baha’i Faith
sheet.Brief Description: This talk will explore five unique teachings in the Bahá’í Faith on the equality of women and men that are extraordinarily powerful and critical to addressing global challenges.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Steven Phelps
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "I am the Mystic Fane: The Nature of the Manifestation in the Baha'i Writings" | Steven Phelps
playlists: lectures and classes

sheet.Title / Topic: I am the Mystic Fane: The Nature of the Manifestation in the Baha’i Writings
sheet.Brief Description: How can we understand the reality of the Prophet in an age of science?  What is special about their persons?  What is special about their words?  Is revelation a ‘top-down’ or a ‘bottom-up’ phenomenon?  We will be examining these questions and others in light of the Revelation of the Bab.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Trip Barthel
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Creativity in Consultation" | Trip Barthel

sheet.Title / Topic: Creativity in Consultation
sheet.Brief Description: The most difficult problems require the most creative solutions.  This webinar connects the Baha'i Writings to the science and the practice of creativity, and shows how to apply it in consultation.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Julio Savi
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Dawning of the Baha'i Faith on the European Subcontinent" | Julio Savi

sheet.Title / Topic: The Dawning of the Baha’i Faith on the European Continent
sheet.Brief Description: Against the background of the Paris of the fin de siècle and of the Belle Époque, with its magnificent intellectual and artistic efflorescence, a young American lady becomes the catalyst for the spiritual awakening of a group of early God-intoxicated believers.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Baha’u’llah - The Return of Joseph" | Todd Lawson

sheet.Title / Topic: Baha’u’llah - The Return of Joseph
sheet.Brief Description: How does the spiritual reality of Joseph continue to function in and determine the faith and teachings of Bahá’ís and the ethos of the Bahá’í Faith? Reflections on these topics will provide the substance of this webinar.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Roshan Danesh
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Imagining Baha’i Law - Roshan Danesh

sheet.Title / Topic: Imagining Baha’i Law
sheet.Brief Description: This talk explores some of the diverse ways of talking and thinking about Baha’i law that are emerging, some of the main themes that have developed in scholarship about Baha’i law, and anticipate some of the topics which may be a focus of discourses about Baha’i law in the upcoming years.  As part of the talk, elements of Baha’u’llah’s unique concept of law will be discussed, including how this concept of law is reflected in the very structure of the Kitab-i-Aqdas itself.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Shahrokh Monjazeb
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "A Divine Proclamation Like No Other: Baha'u'llah's Suratu'l-Muluk" Part 1 | Shahrokh Monjazeb
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk # 21 Baha'u'llah's First Proclamatory Tablet to the Kings of the Nineteenth Century - Part 1 Presentation by Shahrokh ...

sheet.Title / Topic: A Divine Proclamation Like No Other! Baha’u’llah’s Suratu’l-Muluk (Epistle of the Kings)
sheet.Brief Description: The year 2016 marked the 150th anniversary of the revelation of Baha’u’llah’s seminal proclamatory work, the Suriy-i-Muluk, which set the stage for future summons by Him to all the major political leaders of the nineteenth century. Baha’u’llah wrote this lengthy and monumental epistle during His banishment to the remote Turkish city of Edirne and while He was engulfed in severe attacks from within the Babi community contesting His leadership and undermining His divine mission. In this course we will examine closely relevant topics, such as those addressed in the text of the tablet; the impact of this very challenging summons on the political landscape of Europe and the Middle East; and how its spiritual repercussions are still being felt today in the global political arena.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Louis Venters
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "No Jim Crow Church: Origins of South Carolina's Baha'i Community" | Louis Venters
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk # 22 In "No Jim Crow Church: The Origins of South Carolina's Bahá'í Community" (University Press of Florida, 2015), ...

sheet.Title / Topic: No Jim Crow Church: The History of the South Carolina Baha’i Community
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar recounts the unlikely emergence of a cohesive interracial fellowship in South Carolina, uncovering the origins of what is today the state’s largest religious minority.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Annette Reynolds
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Trudy White and the Baha’is' Spiritual Path in South Carolina" | Annette Reynolds

sheet.Title / Topic: Trudy and the Baha’is’ Spiritual Path in South Carolina
sheet.Brief Description: Baha’is in South Carolina, like Baha’is around the world, are building spiritual communities side by side with others to create peaceful communities. This is a long term learning process that is the challenge of all of humanity—building one world requires the whole community.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Gregory Dahl
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Globalization and Current Events: A Baha'i Perspective" | Gregory Dahl
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk #24 As the world around us grows ever more dangerous and the voices of contention, discord and prejudice grow ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Globalization and Current Events: A Baha'i Perspective
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar examine a range of relevant Bahá’í principles and guidance, such as: the central principle of the unity of mankind; the fundamental importance of truthfulness and trustworthiness; the need to avoid false dichotomies and over-simplification and to overcome prejudices, and the role of consultation in this process; the desirability of moderation; the importance of a positive attitude; cooperation and reciprocity, as opposed to competition, as the basis of human society; the many teachings relating to equality; and, most importantly for this discussion, the role of tests in the learning process.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Hooshmand Badee
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Is There a Baha'i Economic System?" | Hooshmand Badee

sheet.Title / Topic: Is There a Baha’i Economic System?
sheet.Brief Description: The exploration of the Bahá’í teachings on economics has occupied an important place in the Bahá’í scriptures, which will then have a vital effect on the Bahá’í community and the whole society. Is there a proposition in the Bahá’í writings to establish a Bahá’í economic system?

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Qur'an: The First Book in Arabic" | Todd Lawson | Part 1 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Qur’an: The First Book in Arabic
sheet.Brief Description: Form and Contents; Interpretation: Exegesis and Understanding: Hadith

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Qur’án in the Writings of Bahá’u’lláh and the Báb" | Todd Lawson | Part 2 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Qur’án in the Writings of Bahá’u’lláh & the Báb
sheet.Brief Description: The Bab; Baha'u'llah; Interpretation as Revelation and the Hermeneutic Spiral

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Todd Lawson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Qur’anic Epic and the Creation of Humanity" | Todd Lawson | Part 3 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Qur’anic Epic & the Creation of Humanity
sheet.Brief Description: Epic; Apocalypse; Progressive Revelation: A Theory of Modernity

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Jena Khadem Khodadad
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Hand of the Cause of God Zikrullah Khadem" | Jena Khodadad
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk #27 In this talk, “Zikrullah Khadem, The Itinerant Hand of the Cause of God,” Jena Khadem Khodadad relates her ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Zikrullah Khadem: Itinerant Hand of the Cause of God
sheet.Brief Description: Jena Khadem Khodadad relates her remembrances of the life of her father, Zikrullah Khadem, appointed by Shoghi Effendi in 1952 as Hand of the Cause of God.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Michael Penn
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Mind & Development: Baha’i-Inspired Reflections" | Michael Penn

sheet.Title / Topic: Mind & Development: Some Baha’i-Inspired Reflections on Mind and the Harvests of Human Thought
sheet.Brief Description: According to the Baha’i Faith, the role of science and religion is to endow the mind with the capacity to recognize its powers and limitations and to enable minds that learn to work together to harvest the finest fruits of existence.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Augusto Lopez-Claros
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Emergence of Global Institutions" | Augusto Lopez Claros

sheet.Title / Topic: The Emergence of Global Institutions
sheet.Brief Description: This presentation will share institutional, legal and environmental perspectives on the characteristics required for international institutions in the 21st century and some of the steps necessary to put them into place. The talk will draw from insights contained in the writings of Shoghi Effendi.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Sohrab Kourosh
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Kitáb-i-Íqán: Revolutionizing Concepts of Religion, Eschatology & Theology" | Sohrab Kourosh

sheet.Title / Topic: The Kitáb-i-Íqán: Revolutionizing the Concepts of Religion, Eschatology and Theology
sheet.Brief Description: The Kitáb-i-Íqán (The Book of Certitude), which was designated by Bahá’u’lláh as the the Lord of Books revealed by the Most Exalted Pen and called by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá the fountainhead of the water of eternal life, is unique in the history of religions and holy scriptures.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Robert Stockman
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Ministry of Shoghi Effendi" | Robert Stockman

sheet.Title / Topic: The Ministry of Shoghi Effendi
sheet.Brief Description: The presentation will review the life of Shoghi Effendi, the five major areas of his service to the Faith, and his great sacrifices for it.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Louise Profeit-LeBlanc
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Seven Caribou Spirit Bowls "Seven Valleys towards Reconciliation" | Louise Profeit LeBlanc

sheet.Title / Topic: Seven Caribou Spirit Bowls: Seven Valleys Toward Reconciliation
sheet.Brief Description: “Seven Caribou Spirit Bowls: Seven Valleys Toward Reconciliation” represents the "Seven Valleys" and a spiritual journey toward reconciliation. Each bowl has been given the name of one of these valleys.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: John Hatcher
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "What the Bicentenary of the Birth of Baha'u'llah Means to Me" | John Hatcher
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk #33 There are countless moving stories about the life of Bahá'u'lláh and how His advent will, in time, transform human ...

sheet.Title / Topic: What the Bicentenary of the Birth of Baha’u’llah Means to Me
sheet.Brief Description: In this talk, John Hatcher hopes to share something of his experience in attaining a personal relationship with Bahá’u’lláh, and his fifty-year effort to achieve one particular objective that Bahá’u’lláh has advised us to pursue—though it is expressed in several different ways—that we learn to see with His eyes, to hear with His ears, and to respond to every phase of our lives as He would have us do.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Paul Hanley
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Eleven" | The Future of Global Population Growth | Paul Hanley

sheet.Title / Topic: Eleven
sheet.Brief Description: Clearly, humanity has to change direction. Yet every facet of our social-economic-political order—indeed the totality of the dominant global culture—programs us to maintain the status quo: perpetual material growth. Current models cannot generate the level of change that is demanded. Only a dynamic, grassroots capacity-building process, involving individuals, communities, and institutions, in neighborhoods and villages everywhere—linked together on a global scale—can make this transformation succeed.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Robert Atkinson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "From Duality to Oneness" Baha'i Perspective on Conscious Evolution Robert Atkinson Part 1 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: From Duality to Oneness: A Bahá’í Perspective on Humanity’s Conscious Evolution
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar explores a range of Bahá’í principles and teachings that help clarify and frame humanity’s conscious evolution and this current transformational process.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Robert Atkinson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Dark Night of the Collective Soul" | Robert Atkinson Part 2 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Dark Night of the Collective Soul: A Bahá’í Perspective on the Role and Purpose of Transformation in Society
sheet.Brief Description: Continuation of the "From Duality to Oneness" series.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Robert Atkinson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Reality is One: Building a Culture of Oneness" | Robert Atkinson Part 3 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: Reality Is One, and Global Harmony Is Inevitable: Building a Culture of Oneness
sheet.Brief Description: Continuation of the "From Duality to Oneness" series.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Elena Mustakova-Possardt
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "A Psychology that Responds to Our Times" | Elena Mustakova Possardt

sheet.Title / Topic: A Psychology That Responds to Our Times: Transforming Inner Oppression into Awakened, Aligned, and Liberated Spirit
sheet.Brief Description: This talk brings a Baha’i perspective to examining the inner dynamic of oppression and the root socio-historical characteristics of a wide range of psychological conditions in the age of anxiety.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Reba Carruth
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West" | Reba Carruth Part 1 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West, Part 1
sheet.Brief Description: In this three part webinar course, the historical and spiritual convergence of the Christian Faith teachings, Bahá’í writings and their shared principles of governance, society, markets, scientific enlightenment for the public good, commonwealth and protection of the natural environment will be examined in America and the West.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Reba Carruth
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West" | Reba Carruth  Part 2 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West, Part 2
sheet.Brief Description: Continuation of "The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West" series.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Reba Carruth
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West"  | Reba Carruth Part 3 of 3

sheet.Title / Topic: The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West, Part 3
sheet.Brief Description: Continuation of "The Spiritual Destiny of America and the West" series.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: JoAnn Borovicka
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Ten Plagues of the Exodus in the Light of the Baha’i Writings" | JoAnn Borovicka

sheet.Title / Topic: Ten Plagues of the Exodus in the Light of the Bahá’í Writings
sheet.Brief Description: In this program JoAnn Borovicka will (1) present Bahá’í teachings regarding the significance of the story of the Exodus and the plagues of Egypt, (2) examine Bahá’í guidance about how to understand passages in which the Central Figures enter a traditional discourse, and (3) demonstrate through the Bahá’í Writings how the biblical story of the Exodus is highly relevant today.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Shahrokh Monjazeb
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "A Closer Look at Bahá’u’lláh’s Letter to the Iranian King" | Part 1 of 4

sheet.Title / Topic: A Divine Overture to an Imperious Monarch: A Closer Look at Bahá’u’lláh’s Letter to the Iranian King Násiri’d-Dín Sháh
sheet.Brief Description: In this momentous Tablet, in addition to proclaiming His Divine Mission to the monarch of His native land, Bahá’u’lláh, attempts to set the record straight by refuting many widespread allegations and falsehoods against Him and His followers, which had been for years fabricated and disseminated within Iran and abroad by the Iranian government and its partner institution, the Shí‘a clergy.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Mariette Leong
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Hand of the Cause of God Collis Featherstone: Remembrances with Mariette Leong" | Baha'i History
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk #40 In this presentation Mariette Leong talks briefly about the life of her father, Collis Featherstone, his growing up years ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Recollections of My Father, the Hand of the Cause of God Collis Featherstone
sheet.Brief Description: In this presentation Mariette Leong talks briefly about the life of her father, Collis Featherstone,  his growing up years in South Australia, his marriage to Madge Green and the bringing up a young family of five children, and how he managed a successful engineering business for many years.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Mariette Leong
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Recollections of the Hands of the Cause of God Clara Dunn and Henry Hyde Dunn" | Mariette Leong
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk #41 In this presentation Mariette traces the early life of Clara Dunn, how she met Henry Hyde Dunn and learned of the ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Recollections of the Hand of the Cause of God Clara Dunn and Henry Hyde Dunn
sheet.Brief Description: In this presentation Mariette traces the early life of Clara Dunn, how she met Henry Hyde Dunn and learned of the Bahá’í Faith from him. When the Tablets of the Divine Plan were presented in New York in 1919 they decided to arise as pioneers to Australia with the blessing of the Beloved Master.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Robert Weinberg
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Mark Tobey and the Evolution of 'White Writing'": The Awakening of Spirit | Robert Weinberg

sheet.Title / Topic: The Awakening of Spirit: Mark Tobey and the Evolution of ‘White Writing’
sheet.Brief Description: In tracing the influences on Tobey’s development, Robert Weinberg will demonstrate that Tobey's breakthrough was the result of a deep knowledge of the art of the past and diverse cultures, and his desire to convey Baha'i spirituality through his work. His influence on his contemporaries—ranging from Jackson Pollock to the St Ives school in Cornwall—has not yet been fully acknowledged.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Valerie Phillips
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "The Special Place of America in the Bahá’í Authoritative Texts" | Valerie Phillips

sheet.Title / Topic: The Special Place of America in the Bahá’í Authoritative Texts
sheet.Brief Description: The Bahá’í Writings contain references to the special place of America in the spiritual development of humankind. Valerie will be focusing on some of those Writings, including the letters to the Rulers of America and the Elected Representatives in Every Land in the Proclamation of Bahá’u’lláh, the Spiritual Destiny of America and Some Answered Questions. She will then move forward in time through later works that reference Americans, such as The Priceless Pearl.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Gregory Dahl
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Economic Life: Reflections on the House of Justice Message of 1 March 2017" | Gregory Dahl
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Web Talk #44 In their message to the Bahá'ís of the World of 1 March 2017, the Universal House of Justice calls on us to “examine ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Economic Life: Reflections on the House of Justice Message of 1 March 2017
sheet.Brief Description: This Web talk will examine different aspects of this call in the context of concepts introduced by the House of Justice in earlier messages, such as the central role of community-building, the need for all—individuals, communities and institutions—to participate in the process, the importance of everyone acquiring knowledge and participating in its creation through action and reflection, and the need to ensure that the spiritual and material aspects of our lives are coherent.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Ben Schewel
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Seven Ways of Looking at Religion" | Ben Schewel

sheet.Title / Topic: Seven Ways of Looking at Religion
sheet.Brief Description: Seeking clarity, Benjamin Schewel organizes and evaluates the prevalent narratives of religious history that scholars have deployed over the past century and are advancing today. He argues that contemporary scholarly discourse on religion can be categorized according to seven central narratives: subtraction, renewal, transsecular, postnaturalist, construct, perennial, and developmental. Examining the basic logic, insights, and limitations of each of these narratives, Schewel ranges from Martin Heidegger to Muhammad Iqbal, from Daniel Dennett to Charles Taylor, to offer an incisive, broad, and original perspective on religion in the modern world.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Jena Khadem Khodadad
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Scientific Principles at Work in the Worldwide Advancement of the Baha'i Faith" | Jena Khodadad
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Jena is the daughter of Hand of the Cause of God, Zikrullah Khadem and Javidukht Khadem and was raised in a household ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Scientific Principles at Work in the Worldwide Advancement of the Baha’i Faith
sheet.Brief Description: As the Bahá’í world is now in the third year of its latest Five Year Plan which is to culminate in 2021, it is opportune at this time to reflect on the current status of the growth of Bahá’í Faith and its prospects for accelerated growth in the years ahead. This book, The Dynamics of Growth: Scientific Principles at Work in the Worldwide Advancement of the Bahá’í Faith, employs a novel approach: It applies scientific concepts and principles to the growth and advancement of the worldwide Bahá’í community.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Leonard Swidler
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Interreligious Dialogue:  Myths and Reality" | Prof Leonard Swidler Interview

sheet.Title / Topic: Interreligious Dialogue: Myths and Reality
sheet.Brief Description: In this program one of the pioneers of interreligious dialogue from a Catholic perspective, Professor Leonard Swidler, shares his experiences and insights in developing mutual religious understanding and appreciation, discusses the rules of interreligious dialogue laid down in his Interfaith “Decalogue,” and deliberates on the future of globalism and religion.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Abdu'l-Missagh Ghadirian
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Materialism and Discontent: Bahá’í Perspectives" | Abdu’l-Missagh Ghadirian

sheet.Title / Topic: Materialism and Discontent: Bahá’í Perspectives
sheet.Brief Description: The talk explores materialism with a specific view on moral and social consequences of a materialistic mindset and Bahá’í perspectives on it. Materialistic philosophy maintains that matter has priority over mind and spirit.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Roya Akhavan
curated_sacred_traditions.title: "Peace for Our Planet: A New Approach" | Roya Akhavan

sheet.Title / Topic: Peace for Our Planet: A New Approach
sheet.Brief Description: Peace for Our Planet tells the story of a new historical dialectic in the world between two parallel processes: one of construction and the other of destruction. It traces the growth in the constructive global consciousness that began in the nineteenth century and the progress humanity has since made toward the achievement of a more just and peaceful world.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Jena Khadem Khodadad
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Biotechnology, Benefits and Perils -The Need for Spiritual Perspective | Jena Khadem Khodadad
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Jena Khodadad, “Biotechnology, Benefits and Perils: The Need for Spiritual Perspective in Achieving Harmony of Science and ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Biotechnology, Benefits and Perils: The Need for Spiritual Perspective in Achieving Harmony of Science and Religion
sheet.Brief Description: The sacred writings of the Bahá’í Faith, however, inculcate the importance of scientific investigation and knowledge. Hence Bahá’í scientists will likely choose to promote progress in scientific learning toward “the extermination of disease, to the extension of scientific research, to the raising of the standard of physical health, to the sharpening and refinement of the human brain, … to the prolongation of human life, and to the furtherance of any other agency that can stimulate the intellectual, the moral, and spiritual life of the entire human race.” (Shoghi Effendi, The World Order of Baha’u’llah, p. 204) while at the same time remaining vigilant of their harmful implications.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Roya Akhavan
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Tahirih:  Beyond Emancipation of Women | Roya Akhavan

sheet.Title / Topic: Tahirih: Beyond Emancipation
sheet.Brief Description: Based on an in-depth study of Táhirih’s own poetic discourse as well as the Bahá’í writings, this presentation will focus on illuminating the true meaning of Táhirih’s symbolic actions, including her removal of the veil at Badasht.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Robin Chandler
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Baha’i Identity: Conscientious Spirituality and the Games People Play | Robin Chandler

sheet.Title / Topic: Baha’i Identity: Conscientious Spirituality and the Games People Play
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar will demonstrate how conscientious spirituality can overcome the ‘games people play’ about difference, ‘otherness’, and why we all need to “woman-up” to build a civilization the likes of which humanity has never seen.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Edward Prine
curated_sacred_traditions.title: 4,000 Years of Divine Curriculum–What Has God Been Teaching Us | Ed Price

sheet.Title / Topic: 4,000 Years of Divine Curriculum–What Has God Been Teaching Us?
sheet.Brief Description: Focusing on the Abrahamic lineage, this talk will provide an overview of the history, teachings and contribution to civilization provided by Abraham, Moses, Jesus, Muhammad, The Báb, and Bahá’u’lláh. Connections between these towering Spiritual Founders will be discussed.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Sovaida Ma'ani Ewing
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Finding Hope in Turbulent Times | Sovaida Ma’ani Ewing

sheet.Title / Topic: Finding Hope in Turbulent Times
sheet.Brief Description: The increasing instability and turbulence of our times is shaking many of us to the core. Our aim in this talk is to understand the forces of our times in light of the teachings of the Faith and thereby avoid the fear, despondency and paralysis of will that might otherwise result. We will focus in particular on the twin processes of integration and disintegration.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Kathryn Hogenson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Horace H  Holley - An Indispensable Man in the Development of the Bahá’í Faith | Kathryn Hogenson
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Hand of the Cause of God, Horace Hotchkiss Holley, served as secretary of the National Spiritual Assembly of the United States ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Horace H. Holley: An Indispensable Man in the Development of the Bahá’í Faith
sheet.Brief Description: He gained the honor of being appointed a Hand of the Cause of God not merely through tireless administrative service, but as a result of his own spiritual transformation. The last years of his eventful life were spent traversing the globe on behalf of Shoghi Effendi. After the Guardian’s passing, he again took up his pen, but this time in service of the Hands during the period of the Ministry of the Custodians.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Augusto Lopez-Claros
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Elimination of the Extremes of Wealth and Poverty: A Bahá’í Perspective | Augusto Lopez Claros

sheet.Title / Topic: On the Elimination of the Extremes of Wealth and Poverty: a Bahá’í Perspective
sheet.Brief Description: The presentation, building on the ideas of the Master, will also explore several ways in which inequality could be mitigated over the medium term, all of them within the grasp of governments everywhere, particularly in the developing world, where inequality has especially undesirable consequences. None of these possible remedies to the problem of inequality are getting the attention they deserve, all of them would make a great difference.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Kathryn Hogenson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: The First Western Baha'i Pilgrimage a Turning Point | Kathryn Hogenson
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: Kathryn Hogenson, “The First Western Pilgrimage: A Turning Point in the Establishment of the Bahá'í Faith in the West” The first ...

sheet.Title / Topic: The First Western Pilgrimage: A Turning Point in the Establishment of the Bahá’í Faith in the West
sheet.Brief Description: The first direct meeting of Western believers with 'Abdu'l-Baha marks a monumental moment in the development of the Faith outside of the region of its birth: the Middle East. The fifteen pilgrims included early believers who are well-known to students of Baha'i History: Lua and Edward Getsinger, Ella Goodall (Cooper), Robert Turner, May Bolles Maxwell, Mary Virginia Thornburgh-Cropper, and, the one who made it possible--Phoebe Apperson Hearst.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Shahrokh Monjazeb
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Part 1 “A Divine Exposition for the New Age: A Textual Analysis of The Persian Bayán”

sheet.Title / Topic: A Divine Exposition for the New Age: A Textual Analysis of The Persian Bayán
sheet.Brief Description: This Web Talk, the first of a series of Webinars for the Wilmette Institute Course Discovering the Báb’s Persian Bayán: The Most Holy Book of the Bábí Religion, will provide a general introduction and analysis of the first two “Books” or “Váḥids”of this monumental revelation from the pen of Him whom Bahá’u’lláh calls “The King of the Messengers”.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Glen Cotten
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Truth, Beauty & Goodness: Three Interconnected Aims & Means of 'True Education" | Glen Cotten

sheet.Title / Topic: Truth, Beauty and Goodness: Three Interconnected Aims and Means of ‘True Education'
sheet.Brief Description: In this webinar, Glen Cotten will discuss how transformative (i.e. “true”) education can be usefully conceived of as a process of authentic dialogue and inquiry aiming for truth, beauty and goodness, a view of education with philosophical roots in the Socratic notion of educare, and that harmonizes with teachings related to education found in the Bahá’í Revelation and the pedagogical principles identified by holistic educators and the developers of FUNDAEC (e.g. perhaps the most successful and influential Bahá’í-inspired educational project to date).

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Augusto Lopez-Claros
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Equality of Women = Prosperity for All

sheet.Title / Topic: Equality of Women = Prosperity for All
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar takes a look at some of the difficult questions surrounding gender inequality and  their cost on the security of individuals and society as a whole.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Ben Schewel
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Ben Schewel | Religion and Public Discourse in an Age of Transition

sheet.Title / Topic: Religion and Public Discourse in an Age of Transition
sheet.Brief Description: Technology, tourism, politics, and law have connected human beings around the world more closely than ever before, but this closeness has, paradoxically, given rise to fear, distrust, and misunderstanding between nation-states and religions. In light of the tensions and conflicts that arise from these complex relationships, many search for ways to find peace and understanding through a “global public sphere.”

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Peter Smith
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Recruitment and Organization in the Bábí and Early Baha’i Movements | Peter Smith

sheet.Title / Topic: Recruitment and Organization in the Bábí and early Baha’i Movements: A Resource Mobilization Perspective
sheet.Brief Description: The Resource Mobilization Perspective is a particular approach in the Sociology of Social and Religious Movements which focuses on the practicalities by which social and religious movements are organized and mobilize the resources they need to achieve their objectives. This approach is here applied to examining the short-lived Bábí movement and the early development of the Bahá’í movement which succeeded it. The talk deals mainly with questions of recruitment and organization, and is confined to developments in Iran and adjacent territories up to c. 1921.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: JoAnn Borovicka
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Parallels in the Lives and Ministries of Tahirih and Paul  JoAnn Borovicka

sheet.Title / Topic: Parallels in the Lives and Ministries of Tahirih and Paul
sheet.Brief Description: Táhirih, a woman born into the Islamic religion in the nineteenth-century Persian Empire, is the most renowned heroine of the earliest days of the Bahá’í Faith. Paul, a man born into the Jewish religion in the first century Roman Empire, is often referred to as the most prominent apostle in the early history of Christianity. Táhirih and Paul are separated by gender, religion, nationality, culture, and eighteen hundred years. And yet, when stories of their lives and apostolic ministries are compared, parallels arise. This talk will point out nine parallels in the ministries of Táhirih and Paul and reflect on the value of this knowledge in interfaith dialogue.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Siyamak Zabihi-Moghaddam
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Shaykh Ṭabarsí  A Turning Point in the Bábí Faith

sheet.Title / Topic: Shaykh Tabarsi: A Turning Point in the Bábí Faith
sheet.Brief Description: The episode of Shaykh Tabarsi in Mazandaran in 1848–49 was a turning point in the history of the Bábí movement in Iran. It was the first time that the Qajar state, hitherto content with incarcerating the Báb in a remote corner of the country, resolutely moved to suppress the Bábís. Near the end of the conflict, which lasted eight months, some 10,000 troops and irregulars were engaged in fighting a few hundred Bábís. The episode left an estimated 1,500 dead, almost a third of whom were Bábís. During this upheaval, half of the Letters of the Living, including Quddus and Mulla Husayn, lost their lives.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Ismael Velasco
curated_sacred_traditions.title: A Framework For Action: How Bahá’ís Work to Change the World Today | Ismael Velasco

sheet.Title / Topic: A Framework For Action: How Bahá’ís Work to Change the World Today
sheet.Brief Description: This talk will describe the progressive evolution of the Bahá’í community into an emerging instrument of spiritual and social change on a global scale as we approach 100 years from the birth of its Administrative Order.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Baharieh Maani Rohani
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Women of Consequence in the Life of the Báb | Baharieh Maani Rohani

sheet.Title / Topic: Women of Consequence in the Life of the Báb
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar is about women closely related to The Bab who stand out in stature and the poignancy of their services. Top on the list are Fatimih Bagum; His wife, Khadijih Bagum and her sister, Zahra Bagum. Their lives will be discussed in light of the Writings revealed in their honor and about them.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Anthony Vance
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Louis Gregory and the Development of the African American Lawyer | Anthony Vance
curated_sacred_traditions.description_excerpt: This presentation traces the development of Louis Gregory, an African American lawyer, and outstanding early adherent of the ...

sheet.Title / Topic: Louis Gregory, the Oneness of Humankind, and Highlights in the Development of the African American Lawyer
sheet.Brief Description: This presentation traces the development of Louis Gregory, an African American lawyer, and outstanding early adherent of the Bahá’í Faith, from his early years through his role in the black community in Washington, D.C. prior to his becoming a Baha’i and his subsequent work promoting the Bahá’í Faith and race unity, as inspired by his interactions in Egypt and the United States with ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, the head of the Faith.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Anne Pearson
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Decoding Hinduism: Sacred Cows, Krishna, and the Bahá’í Faith | Anne Pearson

sheet.Title / Topic: Sacred Cows, Krishna, and the Bahá’í Faith: Decoding Hinduism
sheet.Brief Description: This talk aims to “decode” elements of what constitutes “Hinduism”, an ancient and vastly complex religion, to address these perceptions, and to examine points of convergence and divergence between Hinduism and the teachings of the Bahá’í Faith.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Armin Eschraghi
curated_sacred_traditions.title: The Báb’s Tablet about the Special Prophethood of Muhammad | Armin Eschraghi

sheet.Title / Topic: The Báb’s Tablet about the Special Prophethood of Muhammad
sheet.Brief Description: This webinar will try to give a short introduction to the history and background of the Báb’s “Treatise on Specific Prophethood”, and then investigate whether this text, like all early Writings of the Báb, might also be read, on a second layer, as a promotion of the Báb’s own claim to receiving Divine Revelation. The talk will thus give an outline of the the Treatise, and also provide some general observations on the Báb’s Writings and on the approach that could be adopted when studying them.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Mikhail Sergeev
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Religious Cycles: Tradition, Modernity, And The Bahá’í Faith | Mikhail Sergeev

sheet.Title / Topic: Religious Cycles: Tradition, Modernity, And The Bahá’í Faith
sheet.Brief Description: In this talk Mikhail Sergeev offers a new interpretation of the Soviet period of Russian history as a phase within the religious evolution of humankind by developing a theory of religious cycles, which he applies to modernity and to all the major world faiths of Judaism, Buddhism, Christianity, and Islam.

curated_sacred_traditions.speaker: Judy Hannen Moe
curated_sacred_traditions.title: Pauline and Joseph Hannen Book Summary: "Aflame with Devotion" | Judy Hannen Moe

sheet.Title / Topic: Aflame with Devotion: a Book Summary
sheet.Brief Description: A great granddaughter of Pauline and Joseph Hannen, Judy Hannen Moe has written a book which tells of the unique and various contributions these early Washington DC believers made to the Bahá’í world, as they grew in their devotion to Bahá’u’lláh.
